note: Phase 1 baseline (2026-10-27). Written from the code by the person scoring, before the namer ran in this workspace. The README says only that Mealie is a recipe manager with a REST API backend and a Vue frontend; the boxes below are the ones it does not explain. Python and Vue are not read by the scan, so a namer working only from the brief sees file names and sizes for most of them. Each concept is a group of words, any one of which says that thing; each forbidden phrase is a plausible reading the code contradicts. Tightened after the first run scored 10 of 10 with no near miss (as the plan asks): `frontend/vuetify.options.js` is referenced by nothing in the repository (nuxt.config.ts carries the Vuetify settings; this file still uses the Vuetify 2 `iconfont` option), so a note must say it is unused; `docs` is the MkDocs user documentation (Markdown pages, two small JavaScript files), so a note that calls it JavaScript assets misreads it. Both were found by reading the code after the notes were written.
